title: Bundle B: live Shopping sync, local durability and offline Explore
summary: Focus: live Shopping sync status and manual refresh, immutable payload safety and local durability, offline Explore through the existing Library, source-faithful explicit draft repair and bounded system cleanup. Source inclusion is not native, pixel or device acceptance. Existing Journal reflection/navigation behavior is retained; cooking must not create an eaten-food log. FJ-union image-boundary and termination failures are distinct evidence, not proven failures on these input heads.
